name: 鄭麗玲
objective:
導覽解說技巧與實務課程旨在介紹各種不同環境、空間與目的之導覽實務，除了學習制式導覽技能，導覽解說人員亦並時時充實各式導覽內容所需相關知識。課程內容包含導覽解說流程、導覽技巧訓練、操作導覽器具、製作導覽手冊、筆記等。
The course aims to introduce various practical skills and techniques for guiding in different environments, spaces, and purposes. In addition to learning formal guiding skills, tour guides are also required to constantly enrich their knowledge of relevant content for various tours. The course content includes the process of tour guiding, training in guiding techniques, operating guiding equipment, creating tour guides brochure, note-taking, and more.

scorePolicy:
1. 校內導覽實作，每人 5 分鐘。
2. 分組導覽影片與導覽手冊口頭報告，一組 5 人，共 6 組 (31 人計)，每組報告 8 分鐘。十七週報告完同時繳交書面與電子檔
3. 作業於網路學園繳交，會有一次補交機會。學習單一律演講結束收回，無補交
4. 平時考核 80%：分組作業 25%、出缺席 10%、個人導覽 15%、各項作業 30%。紙筆測驗 20%

延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.

課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）
